parsed.explanation: The strongest traveller-facing evidence is the 2023 legal-research finding of 12 incidents (2018-2022) in which entry was refused or deportation ordered for perceived queer travellers, with no charge needed. Police entrapment via dating apps, with transgender women named as targets, is documented as a national pattern, and the 2026 overview confirms morality and sex-work laws are routinely used for arrests carrying prison terms. Custody includes documented physical abuse and coerced anal examinations, though the last dated forced-exam incident is 2017. Official incitement and state-directed targeting add weight. No specific visitor-facing screening protocol is documented, and the closure of legal gender recognition and the health discrimination are resident-facing, so they are not scored directly. No execution is documented. Overall this is state-directed targeting with no effective recourse, in the high-risk band.
